sourceReviewDecision: I reviewed the round-8 delta (db3d9a8..2db77c4) against main f2e5f19. The exported validators in prerequisiteRecords.ts are now wrapped by shaped(); validateKnowledge is still unwrapped, but only internal validators and the stored-data read path in nativeTypedRead.ts call it. ownerWrite rejects a non-object payload. Withheld Section, Unit and TextbookEdition exact reads check the requested revision against currentCatalogPins. A scratch probe showed SC-CAT really reaches that withheld path: at the default revision it returns UNKNOWN, and at a wrong revision it returns REVISION_STALE. The link dedupe key now records whether a link came from the lesson payload or a dated binding (every emitLink caller is a payload link), and SC-WITNESS would fail under the old key. RC9 runs every operation through the real TeacherApplication on the in-memory FictionalSql store. In student-name-search.test.ts, all six original cases run in a `bun test --preload=network-deny <exact file>` child with only PATH, AGENT_PLATFORM_* and the case selector passed in (Bun drops undefined values). I ran the file: 6 child cases and the 1 wrapper passed. No other in-process test installs the guard globally; the other suites only preload it in child processes. scripts/verify-imports.ts passes, with every adaptations.json integrationSha256 matching the head bytes; the name-search test is not pinned in imported-files.json, and source.yml has no diff from main. The changed dc-gang-a suites pass 258/0 with the package's 50s timeout. The controller now reports the failed call site (the require at line 577) instead of the require helper, and its test has no side effects. I did not run the native harness or touch any database.
